speaker: Doctor
text: That rapid worsening over just one week is unusual for typical idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, which usually progresses more slowly. Have you had any recent exposure to dust, chemicals, or bird droppings, and do you have a history of autoimmune diseases like rheumatoid arthritis or lupus?
